Bracket, standings, schedule
 Jesse Yomtov USA TODAY Updated Nov. 17, 2026, 3:31 p.m. ET Hear this story The UEFA Nations League wraps up group play on Tuesday, Nov. 17, with a round of games that will determine the final spot in the top division's quarterfinals – as well as promotion and relegation for next season.
 While seven of the eight quarterfinal spots have been booked in League A, seeding is still up for grabs in Group 4 with Portugal already clinching a spot and Denmark and Norway still able to finish runner-up. The home-and-away quarterfinals will be played at the end of March 2027. The semifinals, third-place match and final are set for June 9-13 at a yet-to-be-determined host location.
 Here's what to know for the UEFA Nations League's final group games, quarterfinal participants and bracket:
 UEFA Nations League schedule: Soccer games today
 All matches kick off at 2:45 p.m. ET 
 League A 
 Denmark vs. Norway (Group A4) 
 Wales vs. Portugal (Group A4) 
 League B 
 Group B2: Hungary vs. Northern Ireland // Ukraine vs. Georgia
 Group B3: Republic of Ireland vs. Kosovo // Israel vs. Austria
 Group B4: Bosnia and Herzegovina vs. Romania // Poland vs. Sweden
 Who's in UEFA Nations League quarterfinals?
 France (Group 1 winner)
 Belgium (Group 1 runner-up)
 Germany (Group 2 winner)
 Netherlands (Group 2 runner-up
 England (Group 3 winner)
 Spain (Group 3 runner-up)
 Portugal (Group 4 tbd)
 Denmark/Norway (Group 4 tbd) 
 UEFA Nations League bracket
 Quarterfinals
 Draw on Friday, Nov. 20 
 QF1 – Group winner vs. group runner-up
 QF2 – Group winner vs. group runner-up
 QF3 – Group winner vs. group runner-up
 QF4 –Group winner vs. group runner-up
 Semifinals/Final
 Draw at later date 
 Semifinal – June 9/10
 Semifinal – June 9/10
 Final : June 13
 When is UEFA Nations League draw?
 The draw for the 2026-27 UEFA Nations League quarterfinals will be held on Friday, Nov. 20
 When is Nations League quarterfinals?
 First legs : March 25-27
 Second legs : March 28-30
 Who was promoted in UEFA Nations League?
 League B to League A
 Switzerland
 Austria
 Sweden
 Northern Ireland/Hungary 
 Nations League promotion/relegation playoffs
 Four League A third/fourth-placed teams face League B runner-ups in two legged series in March. The winners will spend next season in League A with the losers down to League B.
 There is another set of promotion-relegation playoffs for Leagues B and C, with the last-place finishers from League B taking on the runner-ups from League C for a spot in the second tier next year.
 UEFA Nations League winners
 The 2026-27 Nations League marks the fifth edition of the tournament that began in 2018. Portugal has won it twice (2019 and 2025), while France and Spain have each also lifted the trophy.
 2018-19 : Portugal
 2020-21 : France
 2022-23 : Spain
 2024-25 : Portugal
